paragraphs: With Zone & Co aiming to revolutionize financial operations by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP, my experience in deploying AI agents as a Docker container on AWS Lambda aligns closely with your needs.
I proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python, leveraging FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, and PostgreSQL, demonstrating my ability to integrate AI solutions into complex systems.
I have not used Azure yet, which I believe will be a valuable addition to my skill set as I contribute to Zone & Co's innovative platform.
Could we schedule a short call to discuss how my experience in deploying and prototyping AI solutions can support Zone & Co's mission to redefine financial operations within Oracle NetSuite?
